statement: Access to information and systems is controlled on a need-to-know and least-privilege basis.
Access rights are reviewed periodically and removed on termination or role change.
Privileged access rights are restricted and tightly managed.
Secure authentication including multi-factor authentication is enforced for access to systems.
Cryptography is used to protect information and keys are managed throughout their lifecycle.
Logs recording activities and security events are produced and kept.
Systems are monitored for anomalous behaviour and potential security incidents.
Backups of information and systems are maintained and restoration is tested regularly.
Information security risks of supplier and third-party relationships are assessed and managed.
Incident management responsibilities and procedures are established and tested.
Records are protected from loss and unauthorised access in line with retention requirements.
A permanently staffed standby data centre is maintained on the lunar surface.
